Use that same invoice ratio and selection, but calculate the selected invoices’ average product cost across all their nonmissing line costs, giving each line equal weight
Use that same invoice ratio, but set the comparison threshold to the average of all valid line-level ratios, giving each line equal weight

Use that same ratio of invoice sums and selection, but calculate average product cost across all nonmissing costs on the selected invoices, giving each line equal weight
Use the ratio of invoice sums, but set the comparison threshold to the sum of all valid line total costs divided by the sum of their unit prices, giving each line’s price weight in the threshold

For each invoice, average its valid line-level ratios, select invoices above the unweighted mean of invoice ratios, and report their average percentage excess over that overall mean
Average each invoice’s `derived_product_cost` only over lines that also have a valid `derived_total_cost / product_price` ratio
Include only invoices with both a valid ratio and a nonmissing average product cost when calculating the overall average ratio

queries:
WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
             AND product_price IS NOT NULL
             AND product_price <> 0
            THEN 1.0 * derived_total_cost / product_price
        END) AS avg_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(i.avg_product_cost) AS mean_invoice_product_cost,
    AVG(i.avg_ratio) AS mean_invoice_ratio,
    AVG(i.avg_ratio - o.mean_ratio) AS mean_ratio_above_overall
FROM invoice_averages AS i
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE i.avg_ratio > o.mean_ratio

WITH valid_lines AS (
    SELECT invoice_number,
           CAST(derived_vat_payable AS REAL) AS vat,
           CAST(derived_product_cost AS REAL) AS cost
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    WHERE derived_vat_payable IS NOT NULL
      AND derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
      AND derived_product_cost <> 0
)
SELECT invoice_number
FROM valid_lines
GROUP BY invoice_number
HAVING SUM(vat) / SUM(cost) > (
    SELECT AVG(vat / cost)
    FROM valid_lines
)

WITH invoice_stats AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
        1.0 * SUM(CASE
            WHEN derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND product_price IS NOT NULL
            THEN derived_total_cost
        END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE
            WHEN derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND product_price IS NOT NULL
            THEN product_price
        END), 0) AS invoice_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
threshold AS (
    SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM invoice_stats
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_product_cost) AS mean_avg_product_cost,
    AVG(invoice_ratio) AS mean_invoice_ratio,
    AVG(invoice_ratio - mean_ratio) AS mean_excess
FROM invoice_stats
CROSS JOIN threshold
WHERE invoice_ratio > mean_ratio

WITH valid_lines AS (
    SELECT invoice_number, derived_total_cost, product_price
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    WHERE derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
      AND product_price > 0
)
SELECT invoice_number
FROM valid_lines
GROUP BY invoice_number
HAVING SUM(derived_total_cost) / SUM(product_price) >
       (SELECT SUM(derived_total_cost) / SUM(product_price)
        FROM valid_lines);
